items.abstract: <jats:p>As large language models (LLMs) continue to evolve, the efficiency of training processes becomes critical. This research explores the optimization of tree search algorithms specifically tailored for LLM training. We investigate conventional tree search methods and their limitations when applied to the unique challenges posed by LLM training, including the vast parameter space and the need for rapid convergence. By leveraging heuristics and novel data structures, we propose enhanced algorithms designed to improve search efficiency and reduce computational overhead. Through extensive experimentation on benchmarks representative of LLM tasks, we evaluate the performance of our optimized algorithms in terms of speed, accuracy, and scalability. Our findings demonstrate significant improvements over baseline methods, indicating that optimized tree search strategies could play a pivotal role in advancing the training of large language models.</jats:p>
